---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an addition or change
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**

What are you trying to do that you currently can't (or can only do
awkwardly)?

**Proposed solution**

What you'd want to see added or changed. If it's a new tool or env var,
say what it's called and what it does.

**Alternatives considered**

Any other ways you've thought about solving this, including working
around it outside the server (e.g. in your MCP client or a cron job).

**Additional context**

Anything else relevant — this project stays intentionally small and
dependency-light (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`), so it helps to note whether
this fits that scope or is a bigger architectural change.
